insight: Backed by Kakao Entertainment and LG CNS ($13.4M raised); its Genny platform has passed 2 million users.
name: LOVO AI
tagline: AI voice generation studio with voice cloning and a built-in video editor.
description: LOVO AI's Genny platform generates text-to-speech voiceovers in 500+ voices across 100+ languages, with voice cloning from short samples and directable, expressive delivery. The browser-based studio bundles an online video editor, auto subtitles, an AI script writer and a developer API, targeting creators producing YouTube videos, e-learning, podcasts and ads.
edge: Bundles 500+ voices in 100+ languages with a video editor and subtitle generator in one browser studio, instead of TTS alone.
pros: Large voice library across many languages
Auto subtitles and AI script writer
cons: Quality varies across the voice library
Video editor is lighter than dedicated tools
